title: Spindle Torque — Elevated During Entry Move
description: Spindle torque P005 = {val} Nm during tool entry move. Exceeds expected entry torque model by {val2}%. Possible chip re-cutting or worn tool entry geometry.
probable_cause: Insufficient chip evacuation at tool entry or worn tool corner radius.
diagnostic_steps: Check chip evacuation — increase coolant pressure P032
Review approach strategy in NC program
remedy: Adjust tool entry strategy (ramp instead of plunge). Inspect tool.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
